scheme_name: NITI Aayog Island Development Agency Scheme
overview: NITI Aayog serves as the apex public policy think tank of the Government of India, tasked with catalyzing economic development and fostering cooperative federalism through the involvement of State Governments in economic policymaking using a bottom-up approach. It provides strategic, functional, and technical inputs to the Prime Minister and government at all levels, focusing on areas such as agriculture, social sectors, innovation, frontier technologies, manufacturing, services, smart urbanization, mobility, clean energy, improved governance, and development of aspirational districts.
objectives: To evolve a shared vision of national development priorities, sectors and strategies with the active involvement of States
To foster cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives and mechanisms with the States on a continuous basis
To develop mechanisms to formulate credible plans at the village level and aggregate these progressively at higher levels of government
To ensure, on areas that are specifically referred to it, that the interests of national security are incorporated in economic strategy and policy
To pay special attention to the sections of society that may be at risk of not benefiting adequately from economic progress
To design strategic and long-term policy and programme frameworks and initiatives, and monitor their progress and efficacy
To provide advice and encourage partnerships between key stakeholders and national and international like-minded think tanks, as well as educational and policy research institutions
To create a knowledge, innovation and entrepreneurial support system through a collaborative community of national and international experts, practitioners and other partners
To offer a platform for the resolution of inter-sectoral and inter-departmental issues to accelerate the implementation of the development agenda

To maintain a state-of-the-art resource centre, be a repository of research on good governance and best practices in sustainable and equitable development, and help their dissemination to stakeholders
To actively monitor and evaluate the implementation of programmes and initiatives, including the identification of needed resources to strengthen the probability of success and scope of delivery
To focus on technology upgradation and capacity building for implementation of programmes and initiatives
To undertake other activities as may be necessary to further the execution of the national development agenda and the objectives mentioned above
eligibility: NITI Aayog serves as the apex public policy think tank of the Government of India, and the nodal agency tasked with catalysing economic development and fostering cooperative federalism through the involvement of State Governments in the economic policymaking process using a bottom-up approach.
benefits: NITI Aayog provides specialized inputs - strategic, functional and technical to Prime Minister and the Government at all levels (Centre as well as States). The policy interventions include but are not limited to agriculture, social sectors (including nutrition, health, education and social upliftment), innovation, frontier technologies, manufacturing & services sectors, smart urbanization, mobility, clean energy, improved governance, development of aspirational districts and so on. It also offers a platform for resolution of inter-sectoral and inter-departmental issues, maintains a state-of-the-art resource centre, and actively monitors and evaluates programmes and initiatives.
financial_support: NITI Aayog is funded by the Government of India as the National Institution for Transforming India. Specific financial allocations for its various initiatives are detailed in documents such as the State Support Mission, which has an approved outlay of Rs. 237.5 crore for the period 2022-23 to 2024-25.
application_process: NITI Aayog does not have a direct application process for beneficiaries as it is a policy think tank. Engagement occurs through structured support initiatives, consultations, and collaborations with States, Central Ministries, and other stakeholders as per specific programme guidelines.
deadlines: NITI Aayog operates as a standing institution with ongoing activities. Specific initiatives under it may have their own timelines, but the organization itself does not have application deadlines.
implementing_agency: NITI Aayog, National Institution for Transforming India, under the Ministry of Planning, Government of India

caveats: NITI Aayog is a policy think tank and does not directly implement schemes; it provides recommendations and support to Central and State Governments
Benefits and support are channelled through government programmes and initiatives based on NITI Aayog's advice
Direct financial assistance to individuals or entities is not provided by NITI Aayog
Engagement with NITI Aayog is typically through official channels, consultations, or as part of government-led initiatives
